scope: Read-only exact UTC time range database aggregates; hand created_at differs from journal record time, so this is matching aggregate count evidence rather than individual-ID join.

wholeWindowAttempt.query:
set statement_timeout='15s';
with hands as materialized (
 select id, actions from public.hand_history
 where created_at >= '2026-09-30T10:00:00Z' and created_at < '2026-09-30T11:00:00Z'
 and tournament_id is not null
), actions as (
 select h.id, a.value as a, a.ordinality - 1 as ordinal
 from hands h cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(h.actions) with ordinality a(value,ordinality)
 where jsonb_typeof(h.actions)='array'
 and a.value->>'stage'='preflop' and a.value->>'origin'='horse_policy'
)
select a->'observationIdentity'->>'status' as identity_status,
a->'observationIdentity'->>'reason' as identity_reason,
a->'publicNode'->>'status' as node_status,
a->'publicNode'->>'reason' as node_reason,
count(*) as count,
count(*) filter(where a->'observationIdentity'->>'handId' = id::text) as hand_id_matches,
count(*) filter(where a->'observationIdentity'->>'actionOrdinal' = ordinal::text) as ordinal_matches
from actions group by 1,2,3,4 order by count(*) desc;

deadButtonDetails.query:
set statement_timeout='12s'; with hands as materialized (select id,game_variant,button_seat,players,actions,small_blind,big_blind from public.hand_history where created_at >= '2026-09-30T10:20:00Z' and created_at < '2026-09-30T10:25:00Z' and tournament_id is not null), bad as (select h.*,a.value as action from hands h cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(h.actions) a(value) where a.value->>'stage'='preflop' and a.value->>'origin'='horse_policy' and a.value->'observationIdentity'->>'status'='unavailable')
select game_variant, button_seat, small_blind,big_blind,jsonb_array_length(players) as player_count, exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(players) p where p->>'seat'=button_seat::text) as button_in_players, action->>'action' as action,count(*) from bad group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 order by count(*) desc;
